issue_request: FHIR-38992 was a Published FHIR-core change request for the HTTP page summary tables. It asked to add the missing batch interaction to both summary tables and, per the Persuasive with Modification resolution, also add HEAD-use markers/notes and clarify that operation response status codes vary by operation type.

No commit message explicitly names FHIR-38992, but the patch matches the Jira resolution.
additional_context: The active HTTP page is in current build scope through publish.ini. Later HTTP-page work, including FHIR-39135 editorial reconciliation, did not remove the FHIR-38992 batch rows or related notes. Confluence FHIR-I minutes for 2022-10-24 confirm the Persuasive with Mod vote for FHIR-38992. Zulip and broader Confluence full-text searches did not find conflicting community discussion.
